plugins.name: admin-assistant
plugins.description: Secretary-style administrative work: schedule meetings and draft invitations, then turn meeting notes or transcripts into a scannable MoM with an optional reply-all draft. Organization defaults live in each skill's references/organization.md.

plugins.name: lnk-toolkit
plugins.description: Everyday productivity skills: write the weekly Friday team email in natural Bahasa Indonesia with an internal self-critique, and generate presentation slides as polished 16:9 images from a fixed visual framework.

plugins.name: push-skill-to-github
plugins.description: Publish or update an Agent Skill in the xilverkamui/agent-skills GitHub repo, following the repo's versioning rules.

plugins.name: simple-suggestion
plugins.description: Draft an LNK Simple Suggestion (Kaizen) from a short description of an implemented improvement and fill the official FRM-DCI-001 Excel form with an ANAKONDA sheet.
